conclusion.finding: Confirmed static fixture precondition gap: the fresh-page material scenario does not invoke public Files before requiring official Add Attachment. Registration alone leaves the attachment owner registered; the only attachment PluginView is inside a closed, unmounted Radix dialog, so it cannot trigger view activation. ConversationThread gates the adapter on active state; the official Add Attachment is capability-gated. Existing late-adapter update logic supports activation after Files, rather than being the blocking mechanism.
